icons.prompt: Edit the supplied Civilization IV self-sufficiency civic icon. Replace the male apple picker with an adult woman apple picker, wearing a simple rustic linen dress with sleeves rolled to the elbows and brown hair loosely tied back. She reaches up to pick the same ripe red apple from the tree, with the other hand holding the same gathering basket. Preserve the composition, pose, scale, apple tree, basket, warm golden sunlight, dark olive orchard background and rich realistic painterly historical game-art style. Change only the person and her clothing; keep all other elements consistent.
